authority.scope: Exactly one simulator Phase A on the admitted STREAM-B-v2 implementation.

cohorts.arm1: Planned build / competent play; primary reachability and win cohort.
cohorts.arm2: Random build / competent play; anti-fitness and GO comparator.
cohorts.arm3: Planned build / random play; reliability control.
cohorts.arm4: Random build / random play; reliability control.
cohorts.holdout: Planned build / competent play with mix none; veto only, never fitness or selection.

comparators.current-main: Frozen origin/main content under the admitted engine and p9-w0-v2 default policy; this is a content comparator, not a replay under the old p8 executable.
comparators.explicit-off: Treatment content with combat.wardSurplus explicitly fixed to 0.0; acquisition valuation remains, while the surplus-Ward play bonus is off.
comparators.null-card: Treatment projection with facetBurst removed from cards and pools, under the same p9-w0-v2 default policy; it must be semantically identical to current-main.
comparators.omitted: Treatment content with no wardSurplus override supplied; Policy.resolve supplies the preregistered default 4.5. Its four controls and holdout are the main Phase A.

content.nullCardProjection: Deep-copy candidate; erase cards.facetBurst and every cardPools entry facetBurst.
content.sharedPoolSmolderCards: unchanged; no pool removal or aspect rewrite is permitted

crn.pairing: Within each aspect/vow/cohort, identical seed is the CRN unit. current-main and null-card must match outcomeDigest and final RNG exactly. omitted and explicit-off use paired descriptive contrasts.

decisionRules.FAIL_CLOSED: Before rows: any frozen identity, clean-tree, engine, one-shot marker or no-other-Godot check fails. After start: process failure, timeout, incomplete matrix or deterministic analysis failure. Stop with no retry.
decisionRules.GO: Every frozen gate passes. This task still stops and reports; it does not start a landscape or make a P9 claim.
decisionRules.NO-GO: No veto fires, but one or more scientific success gates miss. This is futility for this frozen candidate and Phase A. Stop; no landscape or rescue.
decisionRules.VETO: The fixed matrix completes but any identity, reliability or holdout veto fires. Stop; no landscape or rescue.
decisionRules.futility: NO-GO only; VETO and FAIL_CLOSED remain distinct failure classes.

design.comparatorPanels: Dusk Planned x Vows 0/5 x 200 control seeds for each of current-main, explicit-off and null-card = 1200 rows.
design.fixedLook: All 5200 rows complete before verdict. There is no adaptive peek, threshold change, replacement row or rescue.

mainPhaseA.controls: arms 1-4 x two aspects x Vows 0/5 x 200 seeds = 3200 rows
mainPhaseA.holdout: two aspects x Vows 0/5 x 200 seeds, mix none = 800 rows

estimands.directShatterReachability: Per Dusk Vow in omitted arm 1, fraction of runs with at least one shatter.
estimands.facetBurstReachability: Per Dusk Vow in omitted arm 1, fraction of runs with at least one facetBurstPlayed; direct zero-row law binds each legal Dusk play to wardSpend.
estimands.holdout: Win rates, Vow-5 ceilings and Ash-minus-Dusk lead; veto only and never used to choose or fit a setting.
estimands.identity: H10 Ash shatters, H11 source-scoped player-origin Dusk enemy-Smolder applications, Ash facetBurst plays, and current-main/null-card digest/RNG mismatches.
estimands.pairedWinContrasts: CRN point differences omitted minus current-main, explicit-off and null-card for Dusk arm 1; descriptive only.
estimands.policySensitivity: The same reachability estimand in explicit-off; omitted/default and explicit-off are the two materially different policy settings.
estimands.separation: Per Dusk Vow, Jaccard index of seed sets activating facetBurst and directShatter.
estimands.skillGap: Point win-rate difference Planned minus RandomBuild per aspect/vow control cell.

gates.holdoutRule: Holdout is a veto, not fitness. Its point results cannot select a policy, tune a weight, rescue a miss or rank a successor.
scientificSuccess: All four arm-2 point win rates are strictly below 0.50.
Planned point win rate is strictly above RandomBuild in every aspect/vow cell.
omitted facetBurst, explicit-off facetBurst and directShatter each activate in at least 5% of Dusk arm-1 runs at both vows and have a positive two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound.
facetBurst/directShatter activation-set Jaccard is at most 0.50 at each vow.
veto: Any stall, simulator error, incomplete row, duplicate/missing CRN coordinate, source/protocol/content/policy drift or wall-time breach.
Any Ash shatter, Ash facetBurst play, or positive source-scoped player-origin Dusk enemy-Smolder application.
Any current-main or null-card destination activation, or any matched current-main/null-card outcomeDigest or final-RNG mismatch.
Either Vow-5 holdout exceeds 0.90, or Ash-minus-Dusk holdout lead lies outside [0, 0.20] at Vow 0 or Vow 5.

hypotheses.H0: A provenance, identity, reliability or holdout veto fires, or one or more frozen scientific success gates miss.
hypotheses.H1: Every provenance, identity, reliability, holdout and scientific success gate passes on the fixed CRN matrix.

nonGoals: No new content, policy tuning, optimiser, reserve seed, retry or second Phase A.
No push, pull request or merge.
question: Does the admitted S1-S4 system plus the single Dusk skill facetBurst expose a reachable, separate Ward cash-out destination under competent play and a materially different policy setting while preserving frozen identity, reliability and holdout vetoes?

statistics.decisionLook: One fixed look after every one of the 5200 preregistered rows.
statistics.multiplicity: The named gates form one joint preregistered decision; no post-row threshold or family change.
statistics.pointThresholdConvention: Arm 2 must be strictly below 0.50; activation must be at least 0.05; Jaccard and holdout ceilings are inclusive at their stated bounds.

system.S1: Optional requires.wardAtLeast uses a generic supported-key loop; unknown keys fail closed; preview mirrors can_play.
system.S2: wardBurst spends current Ward, emits wardSpend, then deals spend*per through hit_enemy with is_attack=false; Dusk-only early return; no RNG, chip, shatter or Stun.
system.S3: Optional aspect is enforced by RewardRules.card_pool; facetBurst is Dusk-only and Ash is also protected by the S2 early return.
system.S4: Pilot p9-w0-v2 values wardBurst at spend*per and applies frozen wardSurplus 4.5 only above both the Ward gate and incoming damage; sampler/CEM extension is separately keyed.
